stories.summary: Madison Dearborn Partners has agreed to acquire Peli BioThermal from Pelican Products and Platinum Equity. The deal provides strategic capital to accelerate the healthcare supply chain provider's global growth.
stories.why: Peli BioThermal is a significant provider of cold chain solutions for the pharmaceutical industry, a sector that has seen increased M&A activity due to complex logistics requirements.

stories.headline: Financial inclusion in Mexico: how it varies between states and municipalities
stories.summary: The 2026 Banamex Financial Inclusion Index confirms a territorial gap in access to and use of banking services across Mexico. CDMX, Baja California Sur and Nuevo León lead the ranking.
stories.why: Financial inclusion measures how many people use formal banking services, which affects the potential growth of credit and payments markets for banks.
stories.original_headline: La inclusión financiera en México: así cambia entre estados y municipios

stories.headline: Sánchez, Feijóo and Abascal: three protagonists of the Spanish elections
stories.summary: Pedro Sánchez, the conservative Alberto Núñez Feijóo and the far-right Santiago Abascal are the main contenders seeking to become Spain's prime minister.
stories.why: Spain is the euro area's fourth-largest economy, and the outcome of its elections can influence fiscal policy, regulation and Spanish government bond markets.
stories.original_headline: Sánchez, Feijóo y Abascal: tres protagonistas de las elecciones españolas

stories.headline: PSEi regains ground after steep sell-off
stories.summary: The PSEi rose 0.87% to close at 5,353.07 after touching an intraday high of 5,419.49, rebounding from a steep sell-off the previous week. Trading remained light and the index failed to hold above 5,400.
stories.why: The PSEi is the benchmark index of the Philippine Stock Exchange, tracking the country's largest listed companies and serving as a gauge of local market sentiment.

stories.headline: Sheinbaum denies that Trump spoke about the cartels at the APEC meeting
stories.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her bilateral meeting with Donald Trump at APEC focused exclusively on trade matters. She attributed Trump's remarks on cartels to an earlier phone call.
stories.why: Trade and security relations between Mexico and the United States shape tariffs, supply chains and investor sentiment toward Mexico.
stories.original_headline: Sheinbaum niega que Trump hablara de los cárteles en reunión de la APEC

stories.headline: The Jeep Recon is already being produced in Mexico for our market, days before its presentation
stories.summary: The first Jeep Recon, an electric Jeep with Trail Rated certification, has been built in Mexico for the local market. The first unit for Mexico has left the production line in Toluca.
stories.why: Stellantis is a global automaker, and local production of new models in Mexico reflects its manufacturing footprint and supply chain in the country.
stories.original_headline: El Jeep Recon ya se produce en México para nuestro mercado, a días de su presentación

stories.headline: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest Abandons Plans for Two Crypto ETFs
stories.summary: ARK Invest has withdrawn its applications for two planned cryptocurrency ETFs. The decision comes as rival crypto funds have registered modest asset growth following their launch.
stories.why: ARK Investment Management is an asset management firm specializing in innovation-focused thematic exchange-traded funds.

stories.headline: Senegal: Impeachment for high treason, a constitutional weapon without ammunition
stories.summary: The PASTEF party is seeking impeachment of Senegal's head of state for high treason ahead of a resolution on a 19 November 2026 budget decree. The article notes the outcome will depend on the ballot box.
stories.why: Budget decrees set public spending and fiscal targets, so political conflict over them can affect sovereign credit perceptions and debt markets.
stories.original_headline: Sénégal : Mise en accusation pour Haute trahison, une arme constitutionnelle sans munition

stories.headline: Dominican Republic Christmas Bonus and requirements to access it
stories.summary: The Dominican government announced eligibility requirements for a 1,500-peso Christmas bonus. It will reach 2,753,781 people and families through direct transfers and cards distributed by community organizations.
stories.why: Direct cash transfers from the state add to household spending power in the Dominican Republic, and government social spending is a component of the public budget.
stories.original_headline: Bono Navideño República Dominicana y requisitos para acceder

stories.headline: Drone Attacks and Storms Disrupt Russian Crude Oil Exports
stories.summary: Russian crude oil shipments from the Baltic and Black seas face loading delays due to severe weather and Ukrainian drone attacks. Delays have affected more than 10 oil tankers at Baltic ports.
stories.why: Russia is a primary global producer and exporter of crude oil, supplying major international energy markets via sea-borne routes.

stories.headline: Nigeria: the financial stakes behind the appointment of Stanley Amuchie as head of Fidelity Bank
stories.summary: Fidelity Bank Plc confirmed Stanley Chiedoziem Amuchie as chief executive, starting 1 January 2027 after approval from the Central Bank of Nigeria. He succeeds Nneka Onyeali-Ikpe, whose term ends 31 December 2026.
stories.why: Fidelity Bank is a Nigerian commercial lender, and leadership transitions at listed banks can influence strategy, lending and investor perception.
stories.original_headline: Nigeria : les enjeux financiers derrière la nomination de Stanley Amuchie à la tête de Fidelity Bank

stories.headline: Historic maximum. Cargo transportation via "Irkeshtam" exceeded 4 million tons
stories.summary: Freight volume through the Chinese side of the Irkeshtam crossing on the Kyrgyzstan border exceeded 4 million tonnes for the first time since the start of 2026. It is a record for the crossing.
stories.why: Irkeshtam is a land route linking China and Kyrgyzstan, so its freight volumes reflect trade flows between Central Asia and China. Rising cargo through border crossings is a signal of regional trade activity.

stories.headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russian Warship and Cargo Ship in Libya
stories.summary: Ukrainian naval drones sank the Russian warship Merkury and hit a cargo vessel in the Libyan port of Benghazi. The operation represents Kyiv's first admitted strike in Libya along Russian oil transit routes.
stories.why: Libya's Mediterranean coastline serves as a key transit area for maritime trade routes carrying Russian crude oil to Asian markets.

stories.why: Minimum wage changes affect labour costs for employers and consumer spending across Mexico. They are a key input for inflation and wage forecasts.

stories.summary: The International Bargaining Forum has extended the Black Sea high-risk maritime zone to cover areas off Bulgaria and Romania, under a decision adopted on November 18. Seafarers under IBF agreements gain additional entitlements, including a bonus.
stories.why: The International Bargaining Forum sets pay and conditions for seafarers on many merchant vessels. Higher-risk classifications raise crew costs and can affect shipping insurance and freight rates.

stories.why: Capital requirements set how much equity banks must hold against their loans, which shapes lending capacity and bank profitability. The Central Bank of Kenya sets these rules for the country's lenders.

stories.headline: Morocco: net assets of UCITS fall 0.28% at end of October 2026

stories.why: Collective investment schemes pool savings from households and institutions and are a gauge of asset flows in Morocco's financial sector. Changes in assets reflect both market performance and investor flows.

stories.headline: Nigeria: Cornerstone Insurance becomes a holding company and separates its life and non-life activities

stories.why: Cornerstone is a listed Nigerian insurer, and regulatory reforms are reshaping the country's insurance sector. Compliance restructuring can affect capital allocation and corporate structure.

stories.headline: Diageo Replaces Pernod Ricard as India's Largest Alcoholic Beverage Firm
stories.summary: Pernod Ricard India's revenue fell 13.6% in FY26 following the divestment of its Imperial Blue brand, allowing Diageo India to overtake it as the nation's top alcoholic beverage producer by total revenue.
stories.why: Diageo and Pernod Ricard are the world's leading spirits producers competing for market dominance in India's expanding alco-bev market.

stories.headline: Angola and Botswana Seek Higher Stakes in De Beers Restructuring
stories.summary: Angola plans to pay $180 million to acquire a 10% stake in De Beers, while Botswana seeks to double its holding to 30%. The moves come as Anglo American pursues the divestment of its 85% controlling interest.
stories.why: De Beers is the world's premier diamond mining corporation, and government equity participation directly alters sovereign resource management and global diamond supply chains.

stories.headline: Swiss Inflation Accelerates as SNB Signals Concern Over Price Pressures
stories.summary: Swiss consumer price inflation accelerated, prompting the Swiss National Bank to signal concern over broader price pressures. SNB Vice Chairman stated the central bank is closely watching for second-round inflation effects.
stories.why: The Swiss National Bank sets monetary policy for Switzerland, where currency strength and inflation metrics directly influence Swiss franc valuation and European trade.

impacts.name: Swiss Franc
impacts.why: Higher inflation readings and hawkish SNB remarks increase expectations for tighter monetary policy.

stories.why_moved: Accelerating CPI figures accompanied by warnings from the SNB raised market expectations of prolonged monetary tightness.

stories.headline: Not the Economic Conditions, This Is the Specter That Caused 17 Indonesian Banks to Close Together
stories.summary: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) has revoked the licences of 17 rural banks (BPR) up to November 2026. The report attributes the closures to factors other than the broader economic conditions.
stories.why: OJK supervises Indonesia's banking and financial sectors, and licence revocations affect depositors, local credit supply and confidence in smaller lenders.
stories.original_headline: Bukan Kondisi Ekonomi, Ini Momok yang Bikin 17 Bank RI Tutup Berjamaah

stories.headline: Uzbekistan Accommodation and Food Services Output Grows 11.3%
stories.summary: Uzbekistan's domestic accommodation and food service sector expanded by 11.3% in output, according to official statistical releases tracking service industry growth.
stories.why: Uzbekistan's services sector growth reflects economic diversification and expanding domestic consumer spending across Central Asia.

stories.headline: Dangote and Afreximbank Partner on Sierra Leone Deep-Water Port and Rail
stories.summary: Dangote Group and Afreximbank signed an agreement with Sierra Leone's Gento Group to build a deep-water port at Banana Island, a logistics hub at Kent, and a railway connection to inland mining areas.
stories.why: Dangote Group is a major African industrial conglomerate, and Afreximbank provides trade finance for regional infrastructure projects across the continent.

stories.headline: CPD says energy crisis, high interest rates no excuse for keeping RMG wages low
stories.summary: The Centre for Policy Dialogue (CPD) rejected BGMEA's criticism of its wage analysis, saying the energy crisis and high interest rates do not justify keeping RMG wages low. The response followed a 18 November media briefing.
stories.why: The ready-made garment (RMG) sector is Bangladesh's largest export industry, so wage levels affect export competitiveness, labour costs for global apparel buyers, and the country's economic outlook.

stories.headline: Latin American Workers Reach 1.3 Million in Spanish Labor Force
stories.summary: Official labor data shows Latin American workers in Spain reached 1.3 million, up from 376,148 ten years prior, driving foreign employment expansion.
stories.why: Foreign labor growth in Spain provides structural support to service and construction industries in Southern Europe.

stories.headline: Peru Launches Auction of Petroperú Real Estate Assets Worth $9.6 Million
stories.summary: Peru's ProInversión launched a third public auction featuring nine Petroperú real estate properties in Talara valued at $9.6 million, increasing total offered sites to 19 as part of state asset sales.
stories.why: Petroperú is Peru's state-owned petroleum company, and government land sales reflect asset monetization efforts to support public energy finances.

stories.headline: Tecumseh Invests R$200 Million in Brazilian Plants to Counter Competition
stories.summary: US compressor manufacturer Tecumseh is investing R$200 million into its manufacturing facilities in São Carlos, Brazil to retain market share against Asian imports.
stories.why: Tecumseh manufactures cooling compressors for commercial appliances across global industrial markets.

stories.headline: Continental to Close 80-Year-Old Tyre Manufacturing Plant in South Africa
stories.summary: Continental announced plans to shut its 80-year-old tyre factory in Nelson Mandela Bay, South Africa. The company cited ongoing competitive pressures from cheap tyre imports originating from China and India.
stories.why: Continental AG is a major international automotive supplier and tyre manufacturer, whose plant closures reflect shifting global industrial manufacturing competitiveness.

stories.headline: Brazilian E-Commerce Platform KaBuM! Generates R$2 Million via WhatsApp AI
stories.summary: Brazilian e-commerce retailer KaBuM! generated R$2 million in sales over two months through its AI automated shopping assistant on WhatsApp.
stories.why: KaBuM! is a major Brazilian technology and consumer electronics e-commerce platform owned by Magalu.

stories.headline: Major Investment Banks Shift Allocation Preference From Brazil to Mexico
stories.summary: Investment banks including UBS, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Itaú BBA, and BTG downgraded Brazilian asset allocations. Analysts cited interest rate, growth, and fiscal concerns while shifting emerging market capital preference to Mexico.
stories.why: Wall Street bank asset allocations drive international portfolio flows and institutional capital positioning across Latin American emerging markets.
stories.why_moved: Widespread downgrades by major investment banks prompted institutional investors to reallocate funds away from Brazil.

stories.headline: Côte d'Ivoire Considers Raising Gold Mining Royalties and Taxes to 12%
stories.summary: Côte d’Ivoire is evaluating proposals to increase mining royalties from 6% to 9.5% and raise the local development levy to 3% from 0.5%. The combined changes would elevate effective gold mining tax rates to 12%.
stories.why: Côte d'Ivoire is a growing gold exporter in West Africa, where royalty structures directly impact international mining margins and foreign direct investment.

stories.headline: Türkiye Jewelry Exporters Call for Removal of Raw Gold Import Quotas
stories.summary: The Jewelry Exporters' Association of Türkiye stated national jewelry exports could surpass $20 billion if government quotas on unprocessed gold imports and extra tariffs on jewelry imports were eliminated.
stories.why: Türkiye is a major global manufacturing hub for gold jewelry, where raw metal import controls directly affect export competitiveness and trade revenues.

stories.headline: Türkiye Machinery Exports Reach Record $23.7 Billion Through October
stories.summary: Consolidated exports from Türkiye's machinery manufacturing sector reached a record high of $23.7 billion between January and October, according to official data from the Machinery Exporters' Association.
stories.why: Machinery exports are a key driver of industrial output and trade balance for Türkiye's manufacturing economy.

stories.headline: ExxonMobil Group Approves $4 Billion Offshore Oil Investment in Angola
stories.summary: An ExxonMobil-led consortium approved a $4 billion investment to extend production at Angola's offshore Block 15. The group also announced the block's 21st hydrocarbon discovery and extended its production-sharing agreement to 2037.
stories.why: ExxonMobil is a major U.S. multinational oil and gas producer, while Angola is one of Sub-Saharan Africa's largest crude oil exporters.

impacts.why: ExxonMobil and partners approved a $4 billion capital allocation for Angola's offshore Block 15.

stories.headline: Standard Chartered Expects Pakistan Central Bank to Lift Rate to 13% by 2027
stories.summary: Standard Chartered projects the State Bank of Pakistan could raise its key policy rate to 13% by June 2027. Sustained double-digit inflation is expected as crude oil prices remain between $90 and $100 per barrel.
stories.why: The State Bank of Pakistan sets benchmark interest rates, influencing borrowing costs, inflation, and sovereign debt dynamics in South Asia.

impacts.why: Standard Chartered projects Pakistan's central bank will hike interest rates to curb oil-driven inflation.

stories.headline: Punjab National Bank Expects Rs 5,000 Crore Additional Provision for ECL
stories.summary: Punjab National Bank announced it will require an additional provision of approximately Rs 5,000 crore due to its migration to expected credit loss (ECL) accounting frameworks.
stories.why: Punjab National Bank is one of India's largest public sector lenders, where regulatory provisioning shifts impact bank capital buffers and profitability.

stories.headline: Uzbekistan Commissions $500 Million Thermal Power Plant in Jizzakh
stories.summary: Uzbekistan commissioned a $500 million combined-cycle thermal power plant in the Jizzakh region, adding 4.4 billion kWh in annual electricity capacity while saving 500 million cubic meters of natural gas annually.
stories.why: Uzbekistan is aggressively expanding its power grid and modernizing industrial utility infrastructure across Central Asia.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: The new power plant increases grid capacity and cuts national natural gas consumption.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Slides Below $60,000 as Mining Profits Decline and Security Risks Mount
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell below the $60,000 mark as cryptocurrency miners faced plunging profitability and rising network security concerns.
stories.why: Bitcoin is the world's largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and serves as a primary liquidity indicator for digital asset markets.
